title: James Joseph Sylvester: Collected Mathematical Papers, Source-Witnessed Modern LaTeX Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 Sylvester Volume I through book page 608 working surface
description:
Dedicated James Joseph Sylvester author record for source-witnessed modern LaTeX working drafts and continuation artifacts. The current public reader surface promotes Volume I through book page 608, with editable TeX, source-scan slices, and continuation notes preserved in the source packet.

Status at a glance. Substantial working surface: Volume I source-witnessed working draft: book pages 1-608; Broad working surface: source witness preservation: source slices and page images are available for the covered range; Limited active coverage: remaining volumes and later pages: staged for continued transcription.

The newest tranche covers book pp.595-608 and structurally represents Papers 59-60. It reports no screenshot substitutions, no placeholders, no includegraphics in the new range, and TeX arrays for the Ferrers partition arrays and ternary-period table. This record is not a certified critical edition; OCR/math-OCR witnesses remain locator/check aids rather than source authority.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
